macros.name: condrs
macros.doc: Connects two DRSs with the middle argument, presumably a logical connective like $\vee$ or $\wedge$.

macros.name: drsalignment
macros.doc: Alignment of the contents of the DRS, in the form of a {tabular} alignment parameter.

macros.name: drsboxalignh
macros.doc: Horizontal alignment of the top-level DRS box in the surrounding text.

macros.name: drsboxalignv
macros.doc: Vertical alignment of the top-level DRS box with the baseline of the text.

macros.name: drscondfont
macros.doc: The font used for the DRS conditions.

macros.name: drsdiamond
macros.doc: Produces the automatically scaling diamond used by \qdrs.

macros.name: drshacksetspace
macros.doc: Place the command \drshacksetspace in your document preamble, somewhere after both packages have been included, to redefine certain setspace internals so that boxes can be properly spaced.

macros.name: drslinewidth
macros.doc: The thickness of the lines used to draw the DRS boxes.

macros.name: drsseparator
macros.doc: The separator between variables and conditions.

macros.name: drsvarfont
macros.doc: Additional font settings used for the DRS variables.

macros.name: ifdrs
macros.doc: Forms two DRSs joined by an arrow.

macros.name: negdrs
macros.doc: Produces a DRS preceded by the negation symbol.
